text_en: Again I looked up and saw a flying scroll.
text_cn: 我又举目观看，望见有一飞卷。

text_en: And he said to me, “What do you see? ” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits. ”
text_cn: 他问我说：“你看见了什么？”我说：“我见一本飞卷，长二十肘，宽十肘。”

text_en: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to the writing on one side, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to the writing on the other side.
text_cn: 他对我说：“这是向全地面散发的诅咒：凡偷窃的，必要按这卷所记载的被除掉；凡起假誓的，也必要按这卷所记载的被除掉。

text_en: I have sent it out, says the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter the house of the thief, and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name; and it shall abide in that house and consume it, both timber and stones. ”
text_cn: 我要发出这诅咒──万军上主的断语──它必进入盗贼的家和指着我名起假誓的家，住在那人家中，将这家，连它的木料和石头一并毁灭。”

text_en: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Look up and see what this is that is coming out. ”
text_cn: 那与我谈话的使者又出来对我说：“你要举目观看这出来的是什么？”

text_en: I said, “What is it? ” He said, “This is a basket coming out. ” And he said, “This is their iniquity in all the land. ”
text_cn: 我反问说：“那是什么？”他回答说：“这出来的是‘厄法’。”他又说：“这表示人在全地上的罪恶。”

text_en: Then a leaden cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting in the basket!
text_cn: 看，铅盖揭开了，在“厄法”当中坐着一个女人。

text_en: And he said, “This is Wickedness. ” So he thrust her back into the basket, and pressed the leaden weight down on its mouth.
text_cn: 他于是说：“这是罪恶。”遂把她再装在“厄法”里，把铅盖盖在“厄法”的口上。

text_en: Then I looked up and saw two women coming forward. The wind was in their wings; they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between earth and sky.
text_cn: 我又举目观看，见有两个女人出现，有风吹动她们的翅膀──她们的翅膀好像鹤鸟的翅膀──她们将“厄法”提到天地之间。

text_en: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are they taking the basket? ”
text_cn: 我遂对那与我谈话的使者说：“她们将‘厄法’带到哪里去？”

text_en: He said to me, “To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it; and when this is prepared, they will set the basket down there on its base. ”
text_cn: 他回答我说：“要往史纳尔地去，建造一座房屋；房屋一落成，就把它安置在那里。”
